coverage.evidence: ChannelCountHelpers.cs:21-69 registers channel.followers, channel.followers.compact, channel.subs, channel.members, channel.editors.count, channel.mods.count and channel.vips.count through StreamHelperRow.ReadNumber, which renders only when call.Args.Count == 0 (StreamHelperRow.cs:147). The only forms with an argument are the raid counts (ChannelRaidHelpers.cs:25-28 and 31-34, args: 1), which matches 'Only the two raid counts take an input'.

Followers and the other counts use StreamText.Grouped with N0 in the channel culture (StreamText.cs:30, ChannelCountHelpers.cs:26). The compact form uses NumberText.Compact with one decimal and k/M suffixes (StreamText.cs:33, NumberText.cs:36-49). A null result or a failed fetch prints the token as written (StreamHelperRow.cs:45, StreamHelperData.cs:368-371). The YouTube member count is cached by CountTtl = 5 minutes and fails when the account is not connected or members are refused (YouTubeMembersService.cs:40, 59-70).

Channel stream rows use TemplateHelperContexts.Standard, which is every context except Viewer: Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord, Webhook (StreamHelperRow.cs:165-166, TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22, TemplateHelperContext.cs). channel, channel.display and streamer use ViewerInfoContexts, which is AllContexts plus Viewer, and channel.id and status use AllContexts (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40, 74-78, 205-208, 216). Viewer Templates is on by default and listed in the Chat area (FeatureService.cs:92-99, featureAreas.ts:26). The template permission defaults to Subscriber (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:626-637).

LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:436-440 sets channel = channelCtx.ChannelName, channel.display = DisplayName ?? ChannelName, channel.id = TwitchChannelId and streamer = DisplayName ?? ChannelName. All of these come from the channel context, never from the invoking user. channel.mention is '@' plus the display name or the login (ChannelSettingsHelpers.cs:21-31).

CountAsync trims a leading '@', returns null for an empty login, and returns 0 when the user lookup fails or the user has no raid stats (ChannelRaidHelpers.cs:76-83, StreamHelperData.cs:257-267, 368-371). lastOut is the DisplayName of the most recent outgoing raid, and lastIn.at is the yyyy-MM-dd UTC date of the latest incoming raid. Both are null, so they print as typed, when that side has no raids (ChannelRaidHelpers.cs:37-52, 87-88, StreamText.cs:118-119). The history comes from journaled channel.raid events in both directions (RaidHistoryReader.cs GetHistoryAsync).

channel.url, channel.login, channel.avatar, channel.name, channel.title and channel.game are DiscordOnly (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:45, 780-786). The url is twitch.tv or kick.com and empty on other platforms, the login is NameNormalized (lowercased in AuthService.cs:555 and ChannelService.cs:745), and the avatar is ProfileImageUrl or empty (DiscordChannelLinks.cs:60-76). These are seeded for every dispatch (DiscordNotificationDispatcher.cs:164-171). channel.name is seeded only in go-live and stream-end posts, and title/game only in go-live posts (DiscordGoLiveNotificationHandler.cs:62-64, DiscordStreamEndNotificationHandler.cs:49). An empty embed link or picture field becomes null (DiscordEmbedMapper.cs:132-152). Use in a command, event response or timer is refused at save with a 'works in' message (TemplateSurfaceAvailability.cs:157, validator injected in CommandService.cs:41, EventResponseService.cs:31, TimerManagementService.cs:32).

reader_answers.evidence: {channel}, {channel.display}, {channel.mention} and {channel.id} read the channel context (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:436-440, ChannelSettingsHelpers.cs:21-31). Only the raid counts declare args: 1 (ChannelRaidHelpers.cs:28, 34).

Viewer text needs the use_viewer_templates feature, which is on by default (FeatureService.cs:92-99). It also needs the reward:input:template permission, which defaults to Subscriber (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:626-637).

{channel} is the broadcaster's ChannelName whoever triggers it (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:436). A null render prints as written (StreamHelperRow.cs:45). channel.tags joins an empty list to empty text (ChannelProfileHelpers.cs:24).

{channel.display} and {channel} are available in Command (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:205-206, 32-40). channel.url is DiscordOnly (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:783). platform.link.kick gives the connected Kick URL or empty text (PlatformLinkHelpers.cs:20, 44-51, PlatformText.cs:20).
